text:
alex_sales: FYI Veridian RFI landing on my desk — deadline EOD Fri. They asked for a capability matrix, POC ops runbook, pricing tiers, and a short answers doc for security questions. Also specifically called out: HSM integration + private VPC + expected throughput for 10 req/s sustained embeddings. Can SEs + PM assemble?

maria_se: On it. I'll pull latest matrix and start updating columns (Hosted / Dedicated / Private / HSM / Compliance notes). Do we have a runbook template for POCs?

dina_pm: Use the sales template 'edge-poc-runbook-v2' as the basis. I'll add a 2-week checklist (env prep, perf tests, eval metrics, rollback plan). @maria_se can you confirm throughput numbers on ded-8xA100 for embeddings? Need an estimate to put in the RFI.

ryan_security: For HSM: we support customer-managed key stores. Private deploy can integrate with on-prem HSMs or cloud HSM via customer-side peering. I'll draft answers for key ownership, key rotation, and crypto attestations. Also need a clear data residency blurb for their EU accounts.

maria_se: Quick numbers: Dedicated (ded-8xA100) with quantized embedding model ~= 600 embeddings/s (batch=64, warm cache). Hosted varies with tenancy but typically ~200 embeddings/s for shared nodes. So 10 req/s sustained is within all deployment modes with headroom. I'll include a short performance note and assumptions.

alex_sales: Great. Can we commit to a 2-week POC with environment ready in 3 business days for Dedicated? Customer asked for pricing tiers for POC -> Prod.

dina_pm: Ops can provision a Dedicated trial (isolated pool) in ~48h once PO signed. Private (customer-managed VPC + peering) will need 3-5 business days depending on network approvals. Pricing: propose POC discount on Dedicated, then monthly reserved commit for Prod — I'll draft tiers.

maria_se: Adding a capability snippet to the draft RFI (will attach):

```
Feature | Hosted | Dedicated | Private
Encryption at rest | Yes | Yes | Yes (customer KMS/HSM)
HSM support | No (managed keys) | Yes | Yes (customer HSM)
SLA | None (self-serve) | 99.9% | 99.9% + support
Throughput (embeddings) | ~200/s | ~600/s | ~600/s
POC lead time | <24h | 48h | 3-5d (peering)
```

ryan_security: I'll add this security answer snippet to the security questionnaire: "Redwood supports customer key ownership via KMS/HSM integrations; private deployments allow customer-managed HSM with attestations and isolated key material. We do not persist unencrypted customer keys in our control plane."

maria_se: Uploading updated matrix + runbook draft to Drive: https://redwood.internal/sales/docs/veridian-rfi-draft (will attach final PDF).

ops-bot: Created ticket #OPS-4821 for Dedicated trial provisioning (assignee: infra-ops).

alex_sales: Thanks team — can we aim to circulate the first complete draft by tomorrow EOD? I'll send to Veridian after PM/security signoff. :thumbsup:

maria_se: Yep — will have draft by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

ryan_security: I'll finish security Qs and add a short appendix on HSM integration and audit logs.

dina_pm: I'll mock up pricing tiers and a suggested POC acceptance criteria doc.

alex_sales: Awesome — call if any blockers.
